notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig and Mine Worker do not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mine Worker.
description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.
